correctness.rationale: The 2013 exact lower-cover formula is correctly used as the pointwise starting identity. Conditional Narayana moments justify a mean-O(n) and L2-O(\(n^3\)) remainder. Exact sequence-marked Catalan moments of X=Σ_{i<j} f_i f_j have leading square-root singular terms yielding EX~sqrt(pi)/2*\(n^{3/2}\) and EX²~sqrt(pi)/16*\(n^{7/2}\); the remainder and Cauchy–Schwarz give the sharp variance. A unique-giant-component coefficient limit has unit total limiting mass and reduces typical L to total-peaks²+O_p(n). Hypergeometric/Narayana CLT then yields \(\mathcal N(0,1/8)\) after \(n^{3/2}\) scaling. The standalone independent-output enumeration and aggregate moment code pass through semilength ten, with further coefficient checks through thirty-five. Finite code is corroboration, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The source and deletion observable are natural for constrained balanced-word reads and pattern-containment covers. The theorem exposes an unusual rare-event regime: central output-diversity fluctuations converge to a Gaussian at scale \(n^{3/2}\), but second moments are dominated by paths with macroscopic component splits and grow as \(n^{7/2}\), with a sharp coefficient. This is a substantive statistical distinction not supplied by finite enumerations or a pointwise cover count, and informs average-versus-risk behavior for this exact constrained read channel.
